Name: Mind Lasher
Components: V, M, S (a chain wrapped in your hand)
Description: You produce a heavy spectral chain that buzzes with purple-tinted energy in your hand and use it to deal a devastating lashing. You perform a melee spell attack against any target within reach, on a hit the target takes 1d8 plus your spellcasting modifier’s worth of psychic damage.
At Higher Levels: This spell’s damage increases by 1d8 and its range increases by 5ft when you reach 5th level (2d8, 20ft), 11th level (3d8, 25ft), and 17th level (4d8, 30ft).
